meta.protocol: every 2026+ row dropped at parse; choices by forward-chained CV (2022, 2023) (fit 2021..Y-1) on fights before 2024; 2024-25 scored once (valid); corner-symmetric pool (swap asserted); event-cluster bootstrap 2,000 resamples, paired

families.m6: method six-way [A KO, A SUB, A DEC, B KO, B SUB, B DEC] (draw leg in the de-vig when quoted)
families.er: fight ends in round k + decision
families.wr: fighter wins in round k + decisions
families.mr: fighter wins by KO / SUB in round k + decisions

meta.devig: power within each family per book (multiplicative when a book's family sums to <= 1); arithmetic mean over books; a book is dropped when its key scalar is > 0.15 from the median book (>= 3 books); legs >= 1 or implausible overrounds (OVER_MAX) are rejected
meta.timestamps: historical props are BFO's closing prices (no per-book history; its line-history endpoint is obfuscated and not used). `capture` stamps forward snapshots.

method.decision: kept S2+P jlin (best alternative S2+P jlin | dec 0.93623)
kept S2+P jlin (best alternative S2+P jlin | books 0.93524)
kept S2+P jlin (best alternative S2+SM+P jlin 0.93793)

round.decision: kept S2 shapes (best alternative S2+P[wr] lin 1.04905)
kept S2 shapes (no alternative passes the gate)

prereg.scored_object: the chosen pool (spec and parameters above, fit on 2021-2023 fights with props) for P(method | winner) and P(round | side, method), composed with the winner model W_close (cycle 1's close stack, market + ML v2, fit 2019-2023); where a prop family is missing the part falls back to S2 (the degrade rule)

primary.comparison: pool minus S2 cycle-1 cells, same winner (W_close): the difference is method given the winner plus the draw cell
primary.expected_effect: about the CV estimate; V6_V10_PLAN Cycle 2 expects -0.005 to -0.015
primary.mde_note: V6_V10_PLAN section 2: MDE for a method-given-winner change about 0.015 on 2024-25

secondaries: the same against props alone and against the current 40/60 blend (conditionals with the same winner, and as published with their own winners)
P(decision) mean predicted vs observed (target: within 2 points)
failure: primary: pool worse than S2 with a CI excluding 0
method given the winner worse than the current 40/60 blend's conditionals by more than +0.003 (V6_V10_PLAN 6.3 not-worse bound for method)
round given a finish worse than S2 by more than +0.002 (V6_V10_PLAN Cycle 2 gate)
P(decision) more than 2 points from observed
prereg.decision_rule: This is cycle-2 research (no version look). The look confirms or not; it never changes the spec or the parameters. Adoption into predict()/the ledger follows the CV gate; the v7 version look is the official test.
prereg.confirmation_look_note: 2024-25 was already used for the S2 / props / 40/60 comparisons in model_ml2 and model_methodround: the S2 and 40/60 numbers there are known, the pool's are not.

debut_bouts.universe: tools/debut.py debut bouts (a side with 0 prior UFC bouts), decisive, with method props, 2024-01-01..2025-12-31
debut_bouts.experts: debut METHOD model (annual walk-forward as tools/debut.py runs it, fed the close where there is one) and the props' method | winner
debut_bouts.primary: method given the winner, pool minus debut model alone (paired, event clusters)
secondaries: method3 with W = the close (ledger p_a)

model.degrade: no method props -> S2 method | winner; no round props or round part not pooled -> S2 round shapes; no props at all -> the model package unchanged (identity)
